title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
statement_md: Suppose an array of length `n` sorted in ascending order is rotated between 1 and n times. Return the minimum element of this array in $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$ time.
hints: If mid > right, min is in right half; otherwise in left half.
editorial_md:
### Method: Binary Search
- **Time Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$
- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(1)$
